tasks.title: Close the open differential and shrinker findings
acceptance: The shrinker reduces only facts and their matching evidence; relations, rules, claims, mappings, diagnostics, and outputs are byte-for-byte unchanged in every replay bundle, with a test asserting it.

A minimized replay preserves the original disagreement's exact left/right values, not merely the differing field names; a mismatch that disappears on the shrinker's baseline rerun is persisted as the original disagreement rather than raising.
Every operational or semantic disagreement blocks admission with a replay bundle; shrink_truncated is reported honestly when the 200-step bound is hit.

tasks.title: Finalize the kernel closure: boundary totality and differential agreement
acceptance: Both parallel patches apply cleanly in manifest order and every gate of the retired datalog-differential task passes on the integrated tree.

Both engines agree on relational closure and on every claim's semantic verdict, operational status, basis, and missing premises for all 14 corpus cases. Every adversarial kernel bundle is run through the differential: valid bundles must agree on the same fields; bundles built to exercise a fail-closed boundary (resource bounds, invalid input) must either agree on an identical named operational failure or produce a blocking mismatch, per a documented cross-kernel report contract for invalid and exhausted input that is itself tested.

EXPERIMENT-PLAN.md section 27 records the integration parent commit, the applied patch digests, the exact gate commands, the implementer's own run summaries (test counts, exit codes, timings labelled as the implementer's runs), and the Souffle store path. The authoritative gate outputs are the driver's gate-result journal events for the accepted attempt, and the driver appends the checkpoint commit hash in its task-completed event after review; the implementer never records or promises either.

Every deferred item in section 27 names its owning task (the experimental CLI and Linux execution belong to datalog-evaluation; installed-wheel inclusion of the static schema belongs to scip-datalog-differential); nothing is left unowned.

The four findings left open when kernel-closure-integrate was retired are closed with tests: DiagnosticRule scalar fields (when_missing, required, message) are type-checked at ingestion; bundle_from_json converts RecursionError on deeply nested input into the named invalid-input error; every malformed nested-IR adversary either is rejected at dataclass construction or traverses compare() with the documented blocking result; output._joint_environments rejects, rather than discards, a failed mapping constraint when the same evidence is also relevant through a diagnostic or proof path.
